name: Head of Nagaz
summary: Nagaz’s head is proof that Magistrate Maleb’s search in the Alterac Mountains reached the Argus Wake. Maleb fears the group may threaten the Syndicate.

sections.title: Proof for Maleb
sections.body: In the Uplands north of Strahnbrad, Nagaz leads the Argus Shadow Mages named in a letter brought to Magistrate Maleb. Maleb suspects the Argus Wake has joined forces with the Syndicate. Nagaz’s head gives Southshore proof that the envoys have been found.

faq.answer: Nagaz was a member of the Argus Wake and led Argus Shadow Mages in the Uplands.
Nagaz is in the Uplands of the Alterac Mountains, north of Strahnbrad.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Maleb want Nagaz’s head?
faq.answer: Magistrate Maleb wants proof that Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages are in the Uplands, where he fears the Argus Wake may threaten the Syndicate.
The Argus Wake is a group whose member Nagaz wrote to the Syndicate. Maleb fears its alliance with the Syndicate may pose a threat.

faq.q: What are the Argus Shadow Mages doing?
faq.answer: The Argus Shadow Mages are envoys of the Argus Wake found alongside Nagaz in the Uplands.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you carry Magistrate Maleb’s concern from Southshore into the Uplands, where the Syndicate is strongest.
